book.supernaturalcraft.crossroads.azazel: Samuel Colt's iron still holds him. Call him up in a great circle at night and rails rise around it: he will not step inside. Knock him in, shoot him in, or stand behind the rails when he rushes you as smoke. Straight lines, always.
book.supernaturalcraft.crossroads.broken: Break its faces, its wings and its wheels in turn. Meet no open eye, and hide in a pillar's shadow from its light. When it sings its Hymn, ring the bell it sings and it will kneel.
book.supernaturalcraft.crossroads.intro:
You asked for knowledge, so here's the useful kind.

The next thing standing between you and the top of the food chain: %s.

Turn the page.
book.supernaturalcraft.crossroads.lilith: When she shines, put a headstone between you and her light; they crack, so move. If she writes your name, every blow against her pays the contract down. After each burst she is hollow for a moment: that is when to hit.
book.supernaturalcraft.crossroads.lucife: Only holy things truly hurt him: angel blades, Smite, holy water. Everything he does is written on the ground first. Strike while he recovers; when he gathers his grace, stand in a green sigil or a Ward.
In the Cage at the heart of Hell, with the four rings and the Key. He is Lucifer and more: everything you learned still holds, but the floor will not. Keep moving.
book.supernaturalcraft.crossroads.metatr: Write his name to call him. His Hand writes burning words on the floor: don't stand on them. When he speaks the Word from his lectern, obey it, to the letter.
book.supernaturalcraft.crossroads.none:
You've killed everything worth killing. Congratulations.

The only thing left you should be afraid of is me.
book.supernaturalcraft.crossroads.title: What the Crossroads Know
book.supernaturalcraft.hymn.page1: We were a choir of many, and we sang before the Throne. Then the Throne was empty, and our voices ran together, and we became one thing, and that thing is broken.
book.supernaturalcraft.hymn.page2: Above, on the summit, the seven bells wait. Bring the Shattered Hymn to the altar while the storm is overhead, and ring three notes.
book.supernaturalcraft.hymn.page3: Which three? The glass behind this book remembers. Read it as you read these pages: from left to right.
bowl_spell.supernaturalcraft.bind_banish: Binds the nearest creature to the bowl, or sends demons, hounds and ghosts back where they came from.
bowl_spell.supernaturalcraft.concealment: Hides you from demons, angels, hounds and spirits for three minutes. Never from the great ones.
bowl_spell.supernaturalcraft.hex_bags.de: Binds a curse into a pouch to hide near an enemy, or a ward to carry against demons.
bowl_spell.supernaturalcraft.locate.desc: Smoke drifts toward what you seek: a person by their blood, a pet by its collar, a place by a token of it.
bowl_spell.supernaturalcraft.purificatio: Cleanses everyone near the bowl of curses and possession, burns hex bags and scatters ghosts. A variant breaks a crossroads deal.
Calls a fallen pet back from the dark, by its collar.
bowl_spell.supernaturalcraft.second_sigh: For three minutes you see what hides: ghosts, hellhounds, hidden hex bags.
bowl_spell.supernaturalcraft.summon_cros: At night, anywhere: a crossroads demon steps out of the smoke beside the bowl, ready to deal. Bury nothing; just ask.

jei.supernaturalcraft.info.angel_tablet: Dropped by Metatron. Once Lucifer has fallen, write "Metatron" in a book and quill and call him down at night in a great circle with it, two choir shards, two holy water, two feathers and a glow ink sac.
jei.supernaturalcraft.info.azazel_blood: Dropped by Azazel, two vials every time he falls. The Key to the Cage is forged with it. Call him up at night with a great circle, three demon blood, three sulfur and two salt, lit with flint and steel.
jei.supernaturalcraft.info.chorus: Found on the summit of a Hymnal Spire. Lay a Shattered Hymn on the Choir Altar in a thunderstorm, then ring the hymn's three notes on the bells: the temple window on the stair shows them, left to right. Creative players can read an altar's hymn with an empty hand, or sneak and ring three bells to set it.
jei.supernaturalcraft.info.colt: The Colt kills any demon, shade, echo or illusion with one round, and strikes a boss for 60 that no hit cap can blunt (it still stops at each phase). Five chambers, loaded one round at a time: sneak-use or [R]. Its rounds cannot be crafted: forge them by night in a blood circle, eight at a time, once you have held the Colt; a few lie in the Hymnal Spire's temple and with the fallen bosses.
jei.supernaturalcraft.info.fallen_star: Dropped by Lucifer Uncaged. The rarest thing there is; its use is still to come.
jei.supernaturalcraft.info.hell_material: Found in Hell: brimstone in the Ash Wastes, hooks on the Rack, contracts in Crowley's Corridors, shards in the walls of the Pit, fangs from hellhounds.
jei.supernaturalcraft.info.hellforge: Place a weapon and runes, then Grave (tier x 2 levels per rune). Purge returns the runes but one, lost at random (1 level).
jei.supernaturalcraft.info.hound_whistle: Dropped by Lilith. Blow it to call a hellhound to your side for a minute.
jei.supernaturalcraft.info.last_seal: Dropped by Lilith. The last of the sixty-six seals: Lucifer's summoning needs it. Once Azazel has fallen, call her up at night in a great circle with three demon blood, two hellfire embers, two bones and a sheet of paper, lit with flint and steel.
jei.supernaturalcraft.info.rings: The Rings of the Four Horsemen. Each is forged by a rite in Hell, from what Hell gives and what the great fights leave. Laid together on the dais under Lucifer's Cage, at the heart of the Pit, they open it.
jei.supernaturalcraft.info.runes: Carved from a blank rune at a small circle. Each fits weapons, catalysts or both; at most two alike on one weapon. The Void rune takes a tier IV weapon.
jei.supernaturalcraft.info.void_essence: Left behind by the Darkness. Carve it into a Void rune.
journal.supernaturalcraft.page1.body: Demons walk the world at night, wearing people. Salt is your first friend: mine rock salt, or boil a bucket of water dry. Pour it as a line and no demon can cross. Chalk comes from calcite and bone meal.
journal.supernaturalcraft.page1.title: The Family Business
journal.supernaturalcraft.page10.body: Every blade and catalyst is forged by ritual, and each has a tier. Catalysts held opposite a grimoire change your spells; alone, they have a spell of their own. The heavier pieces are carried by charging: hold use, then let go.
journal.supernaturalcraft.page10.title: The Arsenal
journal.supernaturalcraft.page11.body: Grave runes into a weapon at the Hellforge: tier times two levels a rune. Purging gives the runes back, all but one. Edge, Ember, Frost, Leech, Sanctity and Swiftness for blades; Resonance, Focus and Echo for catalysts.
journal.supernaturalcraft.page11.title: The Hellforge
journal.supernaturalcraft.page12.body: The First Blade and the Whispering Codex are bound to whoever forged them. Feed them kills and they grow; starve them and they feed on you. The Codex pays in blood and in your mind. Watch your sanity.
journal.supernaturalcraft.page12.title: Hungry Things
journal.supernaturalcraft.page13.body: A great rite can put out the sun for ten minutes. Under it, demons walk by day, the dead do not burn, and holy strikes bite deeper. Only under an eclipse can the Darkness be called, in a circle of void.
journal.supernaturalcraft.page13.title: The Eclipse
journal.supernaturalcraft.page14.body: She cannot be hurt but through her core. Break the four rings, then the cysts at her roots, to lay it open. Keep her four wells burning: each one weakens her. Carry light, for the dark eats you where you stand.
journal.supernaturalcraft.page14.title: Amara
journal.supernaturalcraft.page15.body: Torches, lanterns, the censer's beam and smiting light all count. She will snuff what you place; light it again. When the Totality comes, stand by a burning well. When the ground is unmade, stand in the light.
journal.supernaturalcraft.page15.title: Against the Dark
journal.supernaturalcraft.page16.body: High on the mountains stand ruins of white stone, a stair winding up to a broken platform. Draw a Hymnal Map to find one; in a storm, its altar's light reaches the clouds. The temple on the stair keeps the hymn in its window.
journal.supernaturalcraft.page16.title: The Hymnal Spire
journal.supernaturalcraft.page17.body: Its faces sing, its wings beat, its wheels see. Break each in turn. Meet no open eye, and hide in a pillar's shadow from its light. When it sings its Hymn, ring the bell it sings: it will kneel. Falling is forgiven, once.
journal.supernaturalcraft.page17.title: The Broken Chorus
journal.supernaturalcraft.page18.body: Only those who have beaten Lucifer can open the way. In the Nether, a great circle with six offerings tears a rift; in the Overworld it takes the void circle, the Key and a nether star, at night. A rift stays open twenty minutes and the way back opens where you land. Lost? A binding circle in Hell, salt, holy water and brimstone, takes you home.
journal.supernaturalcraft.page18.title: The Road to Hell
journal.supernaturalcraft.page19.body: You will not see them. Watch for the air that bends, the breath, the paw prints that burn. Holy water, any holy wound or the Reveal sigil shows them for a while; the Eclipse Sight shows them always. Their bite holds you.
journal.supernaturalcraft.page19.title: Hellhounds
journal.supernaturalcraft.page2.body: A demon hurt badly will try to flee its vessel as black smoke, taking its blood with it. Stand it on a devil's trap, or Bind it, and it cannot leave. Ruby's knife always draws blood. Holy water scalds them.
journal.supernaturalcraft.page2.title: Black Eyes
journal.supernaturalcraft.page20.body: War from brimstone and Lucifer's likeness; Famine from Crowley's contracts and the Darkness; Pestilence from the Rack's hooks and the Chorus; Death from the Pit's own stone, a nether star and hounds' teeth, lit with the scythe. Every ring is forged in Hell, in a great circle.
journal.supernaturalcraft.page20.title: The Four Horsemen
journal.supernaturalcraft.page21.body: At the heart of Hell the Pit falls to the lava sea, and over it the Cage hangs on its chains. Under it, on the island, the dais: draw the circle around its four stones, lay the four rings, open the Cage with the Key. He comes down in chains and leaves them behind, one by one. Six faces. If you fall, the rings stay on the stone.
journal.supernaturalcraft.page21.title: The Cage
journal.supernaturalcraft.page22.body: The yellow-eyed one. Call him up at night in a great circle: three demon blood, three sulfur, two salt, and fire. Samuel Colt's iron still holds him: rails rise around the circle and he will not step inside. Knock him in, shoot him in, or, once his vessel cracks, stand behind the rails when he rushes you as smoke.
journal.supernaturalcraft.page22.title: Azazel
journal.supernaturalcraft.page23.body: The first demon. Only once Azazel is dead: a great circle at night, three demon blood, two hellfire embers, two bones and a page for her contract. Headstones rise around the circle; when she shines, put one between you. They crack. If she writes your name, everyone must wound her before it comes due, or the hounds come. She drops the last seal.
journal.supernaturalcraft.page23.title: Lilith
journal.supernaturalcraft.page24.body: The Scribe of God. Once Lucifer is beaten, write his name in a book and quill and offer it in a great circle at night. He fights with a blade at first; then his Hand writes burning words on the floor. In the end he takes to a lectern on a dais with two flights of stairs, and calls his Book. With the Tablet he speaks the Word: obey it.
journal.supernaturalcraft.page24.title: Metatron
journal.supernaturalcraft.page25.body: Set the bronze bowl on solid ground. Pour in up to four bottles and drop in up to eight ingredients, nothing spare. Light it with flint and steel or a fire charge, then speak the Latin before the fire dies: typos cost time, accents do not matter. A wrong mix blows up in your face. Sneak with empty hands to lift it, contents and all; carried in both hands it spills if you jump, fall or are hit.
journal.supernaturalcraft.page25.title: The Spell Bowl
journal.supernaturalcraft.page26.body: Old graves hold more than bones. At night a ghost rises near them: the cold bites, lights die, things fly. Cold iron and salt scatter it for a while, but it cannot be killed. Second Sight shows it. Dig up its bones, salt them and burn them, and it rests for good. Banishing lays it to rest too.
journal.supernaturalcraft.page26.title: Restless Dead
journal.supernaturalcraft.page27.body: Call the crossroads demon at night with the bowl: demon blood, a bone, grave dirt, a daisy and a damned contract. Name your wish and seal it with a kiss. The debt comes due in days, and then the hounds come. Survive the hunt, or break the deal with Purification and kill the demon before time runs out. Die, and the debt is paid, at a cost.
journal.supernaturalcraft.page27.title: The Crossroads
journal.supernaturalcraft.page3.body: A spell is a Form (Touch, Bolt, Burst, Ward), up to three Effects and up to three Modifiers. Sneak-use the grimoire to compose; each inscription costs a vial of Enochian ink. Spells cost mana, some burn reagents. Demons drop torn sigil pages: read one to learn it.
journal.supernaturalcraft.page3.title: Sigils
journal.supernaturalcraft.page4.body: Place a ritual altar and draw the circle around it on the same level: chalk lines, candles lit where the rite asks. Lay the offerings on the altar one by one, then light the rite (usually flint and steel). If the circle is wrong, red sparks mark the first bad block. Never smudge a line while it burns.
journal.supernaturalcraft.page4.title: Ritual Circles
journal.supernaturalcraft.page5.body: Consecration (small chalk ring): 3 water bottles and salt make holy water. Binding (chalk square, 4 lit candles): demon blood, salt, paper and red dye paint devil's traps. Exorcism (blood chalk square): casts out every trapped demon nearby; each leaves a hellfire ember. The blood square also forges Ruby's knife.
journal.supernaturalcraft.page5.title: The Rites
journal.supernaturalcraft.page6.body: The great circle: a ring of blood chalk with six lit black candles inside. At night, a nether star, four hellfire embers, a gold block and two demon blood forge the Key to the Cage. Use the Key on the same circle, at night, with three demon blood, two embers and holy water on the altar, to open the Cage.
journal.supernaturalcraft.page6.title: The Key to the Cage
journal.supernaturalcraft.page7.body: Only holy things truly hurt him: angel blades, Smite, holy water. The Cage will not let you leave. Every attack is written on the ground first: red is fire (move), blue is frost, violet is a beam (break line of sight), gold is judgement. Hit hardest while he recovers after an attack.
journal.supernaturalcraft.page7.title: Lucifer
journal.supernaturalcraft.page8.body: Jump the shockwave when he lands. Break out of an ice cage with any tool. Hide behind ice from the grace beam. Reveal unmasks his illusions; striking one makes it burst. Bind only holds him while he recovers. When he gathers his grace, stand in a green sigil or a Ward, or die. Break his grace tether by running or hitting him.
journal.supernaturalcraft.page8.title: His Tricks
journal.supernaturalcraft.page9.body: The Archangel Blade smites in a cone. The Colt kills any lesser demon or a boss's servant outright, and wounds even angels and the Darkness. Five chambers; its rounds are forged by night in a blood circle, eight at a time. Lucifer's Grace deepens your mana and makes tier-three sigils, like Echo, legible.
journal.supernaturalcraft.page9.title: The Spoils

message.supernaturalcraft.crossroads.bor: "Call me when you've made up your mind."
message.supernaturalcraft.crossroads.col: The hounds dragged your soul down. The debt is paid, but not all of you came back.
message.supernaturalcraft.crossroads.dem: The demon fled its vessel. It will be back another night.

The contract burns. The demon who holds it walks again, and it is angry.
message.supernaturalcraft.crossroads.fre: The last howl fades. The debt is paid.
The demon is dead, and your contract with it.
message.supernaturalcraft.crossroads.hou: Your time is up. The hounds have come to collect.
message.supernaturalcraft.crossroads.kno: Nothing hides nearby. The demon writes you something else instead.
message.supernaturalcraft.crossroads.no_: There is no open deal of yours to break.
message.supernaturalcraft.crossroads.not: That contract is not yours to break.
message.supernaturalcraft.crossroads.off: "Rude." The demon leaves in a puff of smoke.
message.supernaturalcraft.crossroads.ome: Somewhere, dogs are howling. %s hours left.

message.supernaturalcraft.curse.rejects: It does not know you. It burns.
message.supernaturalcraft.eclipse.begins: Something passes before the sun. The Darkness is watching.
The dark looks back at you, and you see through it. You are marked.
message.supernaturalcraft.grace.absorbed: Light pours into you. The air hums. Your mana deepens, and the hardest sigils come clear.
message.supernaturalcraft.grace.already: You already carry a shard of grace.
message.supernaturalcraft.grave.already_: The bones are already at rest.
The bones are already salted. Now burn them.
message.supernaturalcraft.grave.buried: Dig the bones out first: salt and fire have to touch them.
message.supernaturalcraft.grave.burned: The bones burn. Somewhere, a spirit finally rests.
message.supernaturalcraft.grave.needs_sa: Fire alone won't free it. Salt the bones first.
message.supernaturalcraft.grave.salted: You pour salt over the bones.
message.supernaturalcraft.grimoire.empty: This page is blank. Sneak-use the grimoire to compose a spell.
message.supernaturalcraft.grimoire.first: The grimoire's first pages make sense to you now: Touch, Bolt, Smite and Mend. Sneak-use it to compose a spell.
message.supernaturalcraft.hex_bag.burned: The hex bag burns, and the curse with it.
A hex bag in your pack bursts into flame!
message.supernaturalcraft.hex_bag.slip_w: Something about %s turns the hex bag away.
message.supernaturalcraft.hex_bag.slippe: You slip a hex bag into %s's pocket.
message.supernaturalcraft.lilith.busy: Another fight already holds this world.
message.supernaturalcraft.lilith.cage_go: The circle is broken. She is gone.
message.supernaturalcraft.lilith.contrac: The contract is due. Can you hear the dogs?
Your name is written in her contract. Wound her, all of you, before it comes due.
message.supernaturalcraft.lilith.light_w: Her light is rising: get behind a headstone!
message.supernaturalcraft.lilith.victori: She smiles, and the white light takes her somewhere else.
message.supernaturalcraft.locate.dead: The smoke settles like ash: %s is no more.
message.supernaturalcraft.locate.elsewhe: The smoke sinks back into the bowl: %s is far beyond this world.
message.supernaturalcraft.locate.here: The smoke curls about, close by.
message.supernaturalcraft.locate.no_bloo: The spell needs the blood of whoever you seek.
message.supernaturalcraft.locate.no_coll: The spell needs your pet's collar.
message.supernaturalcraft.locate.not_fou: The smoke wanders aimlessly: it finds nothing.
message.supernaturalcraft.locate.nothing: The map stays blank: nothing of the kind lies near enough.
message.supernaturalcraft.lucifer.alread: The Cage is already open somewhere in this world.
message.supernaturalcraft.lucifer.cage_g: The Cage folds shut around Lucifer and drags him under.
message.supernaturalcraft.lucifer.victor: "That's the thing about cages. They're only as strong as the ones who keep them." Lucifer returns below, and the key cracks.
message.supernaturalcraft.metatron.busy: Another fight already holds this world.
message.supernaturalcraft.metatron.cage_: The library folds away. He is gone.
message.supernaturalcraft.metatron.victo: "Every story needs an ending." He closes his book and is gone.
message.supernaturalcraft.page.illegible: The ink has run; this page is illegible.
message.supernaturalcraft.page.needs_gra: This sigil burns your eyes. Only someone touched by grace could learn it.
message.supernaturalcraft.pet_collar.not: Only a tamed animal will wear a collar.
That animal is not yours to collar.
message.supernaturalcraft.protection_bag: Your protection bag crumbles to dust.
message.supernaturalcraft.revive.no_coll: The spell needs the collar of the pet you lost.
message.supernaturalcraft.revive.no_trac: There is nothing left of that pet to call back.
message.supernaturalcraft.ritual.altar_f: There is no room left on the altar.
message.supernaturalcraft.ritual.backlas: The circle broke. Something came through.
message.supernaturalcraft.ritual.broken_: The circle is incomplete. Look for the red sparks.
message.supernaturalcraft.ritual.busy: A ritual is already under way.
message.supernaturalcraft.ritual.needs_d: This rite can only be performed by day.
message.supernaturalcraft.ritual.needs_e: This rite needs the sun eclipsed.
message.supernaturalcraft.ritual.needs_n: This rite can only be performed at night.
message.supernaturalcraft.ritual.no_mana: You lack the mana to begin this rite.
message.supernaturalcraft.ritual.not_rea: You aren't ready for this rite yet.
message.supernaturalcraft.ritual.unanswe: The rite ends, and nothing answers.
message.supernaturalcraft.ritual.unknown: This ritual names a circle no one has drawn before.
message.supernaturalcraft.ritual.wrong_d: This rite cannot be performed here.
message.supernaturalcraft.spell_page.ill: The words on this page make no sense.
message.supernaturalcraft.spell_page.lea: You have learned the words of %s.
message.supernaturalcraft.uncaged.free: The Cage is open. He is coming down.
message.supernaturalcraft.uncaged.victor: He goes back into the Cage on his own. The Rings are left on the stone.
message.supernaturalcraft.whisper.6: Can you hear them? They hear you.
message.supernaturalcraft.whistle.alread: A hound already runs at your side.
screen.supernaturalcraft.composer.incomp: Needs a form and an effect
screen.supernaturalcraft.composer.name: Spell name
screen.supernaturalcraft.deal.hint: Choose a wish. Mind the term.
screen.supernaturalcraft.deal.line.0: "Everybody wants something. Let's not pretend you're the exception."
screen.supernaturalcraft.deal.line.1: "Ten years used to be standard. Times are hard, darling."
screen.supernaturalcraft.deal.line.2: "Relax. Nobody reads the fine print anyway."
screen.supernaturalcraft.deal.line.3: "You called me. I'd hate to think I dressed up for nothing."
screen.supernaturalcraft.deal.line.4: "Your soul for your heart's desire. Fair's fair."
screen.supernaturalcraft.deal.line.5: "Tick tock. The dogs get restless when I wait."
screen.supernaturalcraft.deal.nothing: "I've got nothing you want. Imagine that."
screen.supernaturalcraft.recitation.hint: Type the words. Accents and spaces are optional; Esc abandons.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.bind.desc: Holds a demon as a devil's trap would; hobbles anything else. Burns demon blood.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.bolt.desc: A thrown sigil that flies straight and breaks on the first thing it meets.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.echo.desc: The spell repeats itself a moment later.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.exorcise.desc: Agony to demons. A trapped demon is cast out entirely. Burns salt.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.frost.desc: Slows and freezes. Turns still water to ice.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.hellfire.desc: Burns flesh. Burns a pinch of sulfur.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.repel.desc: Hurls the target away from you.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.reveal.desc: Strips invisibility, outlines the target and unmasks illusions.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.smite.desc: Holy force. Twice as hard against demons and the dead.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.touch.desc: Whatever is within arm's reach. Helpful spells fall back on yourself.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.ward.desc: A circle at your feet that keeps working and stops hostile projectiles.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.widen.desc: Spreads the effect over an area.
subtitles.supernaturalcraft.entity.choru: A face of the Chorus sings
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.abyssal_shard: Rock from the walls of the Pit, cold as the Cage.
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.angel_tablet: The word of God, cut in stone. It still burns.
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.angel_tablet.u: Use: rewrites your story; healed whole, every harm undone (2 min)
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.archangel_blad: Use: smite everything before you (%s mana)
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.azazel_blood: He fed it to the special children in their cribs.
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.blood_vial.hin: Poured into a spell bowl, it leads back to its owner
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.choir_shard: A piece of a wheel that once turned before the Throne. An eye still watches from it.
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.colt_bullet: Consecrated. Forged by night in a blood circle, eight at a time.
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.crossroads_con: Due in %s hours. Listen for the dogs
Void: the demon who held it is dead
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.curse_bag: Curses whoever lingers near it, all but its maker
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.curse_bag.slip: Hide it, tuck it in a chest, or sneak-use it on a player
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.damned_contrac: Signed in blood. Ten years, then the hounds come.
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.eclipse_sight: Drink to be marked: darkness and blindness cannot take you, the eclipse cannot hide the world, +25 mana.
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.ectoplasm: What a scattered ghost leaves behind. Cold, and faintly moving.
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.fallen_star: What is left when the Morning Star falls.
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.grave_dirt: Earth from over the dead. Hex bags and darker rites want it.
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.grimoire.hint: Use to cast · Sneak-use to compose · Sneak+scroll to turn pages
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.harvests_blood: Demons slain with it always bleed
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.hellhound_fang: You never saw what it came out of.
Use: a hellhound runs at your side for a minute (%s mana)
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.hunters_amulet: Warms near the supernatural. Sigils cost 10% less while worn.
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.last_seal: The sixty-sixth seal. Break it, and the Cage opens.
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.lucifers_grace: Use to take it in: +50 maximum mana, and tier-three sigils become legible.
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.pet_collar.hin: The link a locating or reviving spell needs
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.pet_collar.unb: Use it on a tamed animal of yours
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.protection_bag: Demons will not seek you out unless provoked; curse bags cannot touch you
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.rack_hook: From the Rack, where souls are taken apart.
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.rune.blank: Carve it into a rune at a ritual altar.
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.rune.hymn: Every fourth blow or spell rings out again as holy light
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.rune.leech: Heals you for 8% of the damage dealt
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.rune.resonance: Spells cost 10% less and hit 10% harder
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.rune.void: Drinks the light: see the Darkness
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.seraph_wings: Worn on the back (Curios). Only for show — and what a show.
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.shattered_hymn: Lay it on a Choir Altar in a storm, then ring its notes.
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.spell_bowl.car: Carried in both hands: it spills if you jump, fall or are hit
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.the_colt.contr: Use to fire. Sneak-use or [R] to reload, [I] to inspect.
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.weapon.angel_b: Hold use, then release: dash through your enemies in a line of light.
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.weapon.censer_: Opposite a grimoire: holy spells +25%, Burst lingers, Ward 1.5x. Alone: hold use for a beam of light (1 mana/tick) that lights the ground.
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.weapon.ember_s: Opposite a grimoire: hellfire +20%, bolts burst where they land. Alone: hurls fireballs (6 mana).
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.weapon.enochia: Opposite a grimoire: spells cost 15% less, recover 20% faster, bolts split in three. Alone: a seeking glyph (10 mana).
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.weapon.exorcis: May stun. Brought down from a height, it sends out a ring of holy force.
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.weapon.first_b: Cursed. Bound to its forger. Kills feed it and make it stronger; left hungry, it feeds on you. L3: use to lunge. L5: well fed, it will not let you die.
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.weapon.hellfir: Slow and heavy. Hold use, release: cleave a 120° cone and leave a trail of hellfire.
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.weapon.penumbr: Drinks light from bright places and lit foes. Hold use, release: an Umbra Wave that blinds and wounds (light / 5). +30% damage in the dark.
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.weapon.rubys_k: Demons slain with it always bleed.
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.weapon.silver_: Strikes from behind are double criticals. Kills from behind take the head.
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.weapon.soul_sc: Swings reap a 140° arc and drink 15% of the life they take. Hold use, release: a crescent of souls (15 mana).
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.weapon.whisper: Cursed catalyst. Spells cost blood and sanity instead of mana, chain and pierce. Alone: speak the Forbidden Word to mark a foe (+20% harm taken).
word.supernaturalcraft.subtitle: The Word of God
